verdict.rationale: Gitea's docs explicitly state that users can browse code files and commit history in the web interface. A hands-on community report confirms that non-contributors read source through the web UI instead of cloning, and the repo page shows a Recent Commits view. However, nothing in the evidence mentions line-by-line blame, which is one of the story's three elements. Missing for 10: any evidence of line-by-line blame view, in-depth first-party docs on file and history browsing (history browsing has only a single docs mention).
